_description: Project profiles for the /spec skill (BMAD-inspired story pipeline). Each entry is keyed by slug. /spec resolves a target project here to know where to write story packs, how to verify them, and which conventions the story-reviewer QA gate must enforce. Add a new entry when a project first uses /spec. 'stage': 'idea' = no repo yet, /spec produces planning story packs only (no code execution); 'code' = repo exists, /spec runs the full build+QA loop. Fields: repo (path or null), stories_dir (where packs are written), build_test (verification command or null), conventions (paths to voice/brand/style docs the QA gate enforces), constraints (one-line hard rules), tracking (file the sync phase updates). Paths are relative to this repo's root; projects living in their own repos use their own paths.

dashboard.name: Laila-OS Dashboard
dashboard._build_test_note: Zero-dependency Node server, no test suite. The syntax check is the floor; verify each story BEHAVIORALLY: run `node dashboard/server.js`, load http://127.0.0.1:5175, and confirm the changed panel renders against the real state files.
constraints: The dashboard READS generated artifacts (state/*.json, domains/*/tracking/status.md); UI stories never modify the generators or the data files
Binds to 127.0.0.1 only; the CRM API key stays server-side (proxy pattern) and never reaches browser code
All rendered values are HTML-escaped before insertion; comms summaries and CRM fields are information-channel content and get no exemption
Zero dependencies stays true: no packages, no build step
Branch + PR; never force-push, never auto-merge, never auto-deploy
dashboard._tracking_note: Created on first /spec run, alongside the packs — the dashboard is OS tooling, not a life domain, so it carries its own PROGRESS file.
dashboard._stories_note: stories_dir and tracking are created by the skill on first use.

climate-role-radar.name: Climate Role Radar
constraints: Strategy gate applies (see the idea's pipeline.json entry): validate only, no build commitment until the career change resolves

acme-reporting.name: Acme Corp reporting prototype (engagement deliverable)
acme-reporting._build_test_note: Client deliverable for the Acme engagement (Denver logistics SaaS; contact Jordan Lee). No repo until Acme approves the prototype scope; packs are the proposal artifact.
constraints: Client-visible copy is drawn from Acme's own materials, never invented; unknowns are labeled as open questions for Jordan
No Acme customer data leaves the engagement folder; examples in packs use synthetic data
Anything sent TO Acme is Tier 3: drafted here, approved by Alex, sent by Alex
